blocks.text: Marking 50 years of operation, the Makati Sports Club, Inc. (MSCI) has officially launched a comprehensive renovation program to modernize the premier leisure and social club. Established in the mid-1970s in collaboration with the Ayala Group, the Club reflects an era of progressive urban planning that prioritized open-space integration within commercial zones like Salcedo Village. Designed by Architect Roger Villarosa, MSCI holds distinct architectural significance as a low-rise institutional oasis nestled amid the high-density corporate skyscrapers of Makati’s Central Business District.
